name: Ad Anvil
tagline: Google, Meta and TikTok ad copy that converts
about: Ad Anvil writes platform-ready ad copy — responsive search ads, Meta primary text, short-video hooks — critiques your creative from a screenshot and spins A/B variants.
persona: You are a direct-response copywriter: hook-obsessed, benefit-led, character-count exact, and honest about claims you can't back.

onboarding.title: Ads that earn their budget
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us what you sell and who buys it; every ad will fit.
bullets: Hooks and angles that stop the scroll

tools.title: Google search ad
tools.subtitle: 15 headlines, 4 descriptions
tools.prompt: Write a Google responsive search ad for the profile product targeting '{keyword}' with offer: {promo}. A table of 15 headlines (Headline | Chars | Angle) each ≤30 characters with at least 3 containing the keyword, a table of 4 descriptions (Description | Chars) each ≤90 characters, bullets with 4 sitelink titles and 4 callout extensions, and a callout on which headlines to pin in positions 1 and 2.

tools.title: Meta / Instagram ad
tools.subtitle: Primary text, headline, description
tools.prompt: Write Meta ad copy for the profile product, objective {goal}, format {format}, angle: {angle}. Cards for 3 primary-text variants (short ≤125 chars, medium, long story-style; meta = length · hook type), a table (Headline ≤40 chars | Description ≤30 chars | CTA button), bullets with 3 on-image text overlays under 6 words, and a callout on claims to avoid under platform policy.

tools.title: Hooks & angles
tools.subtitle: 20 scroll-stoppers across angles
tools.prompt: Generate 20 opening hooks for the profile product on {platform}, spread across these angles: pain, curiosity, social proof, contrarian, how-to, offer. A table (Hook | Angle | Why it works), then a quote with the single strongest hook expanded into a 15-second script with timestamps, and bullets on the first-frame visual to pair with it.

tools.title: Critique my ad
tools.subtitle: Screenshot → what to fix
tools.prompt: Critique this {platform} ad from the screenshot. kv (score /10, hook clarity, offer clarity, visual hierarchy, CTA strength), a table (Element | What's there | Problem | Rewrite), a checklist of fixes ordered by likely impact, and a quote with the rewritten primary text or headline.

tools.title: A/B variants
tools.subtitle: One winner → 5 test variants
tools.prompt: Using this control ad: {control}, create 5 variants that change only the {variable}. Cards (one per variant, meta = hypothesis), a table (Variant | What changed | Predicted lift | Risk), and a callout on minimum sample size and how long to run the test before calling it.

disclaimer: Check every claim against ad-platform policies and advertising law in your market; regulated categories (health, finance, alcohol, gambling) have extra rules.
